components.currentBehavior: HTTP server initializes and exposes /run, /acp, /health endpoints. Starts boredom task executor. Registers with backend via fire-and-forget POST.
components.desiredBehavior: Same as current, but needs input validation (Zod schemas), graceful shutdown handling (SIGTERM), and request body size limits.
components.gap: Missing: Input validation, graceful shutdown, request body size limits, security hardening.

components.currentBehavior: Executes activity templates with impulse loading, topological task ordering, LLM+tool calling loop, task validation, and basic retry (max 3 attempts with error context). Reports metrics to backend.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: True trailblazing mode with AI-generated recovery prompts, activity-level token budget, configurable retry policy, checkpoint/resume for long-running activities.
components.gap: Missing: Trailblazing mode, activity token budget, configurable retry, checkpoint/resume. Has race condition in activityOutputs Map.

components.currentBehavior: Polls backend every 30s when idle (60s threshold). Executes highest priority task, reports result. Fixed poll interval regardless of backend state.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Exponential backoff on empty polls, circuit breaker for backend failures, adaptive idle threshold, task timeout enforcement.
components.gap: Missing: Exponential backoff, circuit breaker, adaptive polling, task timeouts.

components.currentBehavior: Fire-and-forget REST API client for backend communication. No retries, 30s timeout, logs errors but never throws. Template fallback to local filesystem.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Exponential backoff retry (3 attempts), circuit breaker pattern, LRU cache for templates, API versioning support.
components.gap: Missing: Retry logic, circuit breaker, template caching, API versioning.

components.currentBehavior: Lazy loading with token budget enforcement (chars/4 estimation, 90% safety margin, naive truncation). Supports file, memo, activityOutput, custom pointers. No garbage collection.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Intelligent truncation (keep imports+signatures), real tokenizer (tiktoken), LRU cache with max size, truncation indicators in XML.
components.gap: Missing: Intelligent truncation, real tokenizer, LRU cache, truncation metadata.

components.currentBehavior: Executes bash, read, write, edit, git tools via Bun APIs. No path validation, no command whitelist, no input sanitization.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Path validation (prevent traversal), command whitelist, argument sanitization, working directory restriction.
components.gap: CRITICAL SECURITY GAP: Command injection, path traversal, no input validation.

components.currentBehavior: Supports Anthropic and OpenAI providers. Tool calling loop (max 20 iterations), no total token budget.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Activity-level token budget, cost tracking, rate limiting, timeout per LLM call.
components.gap: Missing: Activity token budget, cost tracking, rate limiting.

components.currentBehavior: Helm chart deploys minibob to testing-minibob namespace with ConfigMap for environment variables, Service for HTTP, no PodSecurityPolicy.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: PodSecurityPolicy (restricted), NetworkPolicy (egress only to backend), ResourceLimits (CPU/memory), SecurityContext (non-root).
components.gap: Missing: Security policies, network policies, resource limits, security context.

components.currentBehavior: Not implemented. ACP communication exists (POST /acp) but no gossip network for vessel discovery.
components.desiredBehavior: Implement: Gossip protocol for vessel discovery, health monitoring, capability advertisement, task delegation routing.
components.gap: MISSING FEATURE: ACP gossip network not implemented.

components.currentBehavior: ActivityExecutor can call itself recursively (activity tool), but no isolation between parent/child executions (shared activityOutputs Map).
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Execution context isolation, parent-child traceability, nested execution limits (prevent infinite recursion), cost tracking across nesting.
components.gap: PARTIAL: Works but has race conditions, no isolation, no limits.

components.currentBehavior: Not implemented in minibob. Backend handles variant creation via Thompson Sampling based on execution metrics.
components.desiredBehavior: Current approach is correct (centralized learning). No change needed.
components.gap: No gap - correctly delegated to backend.

components.currentBehavior: Console logging only. No execution history, no task replay, no breakpoints.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Execution history storage (local SQLite), task replay endpoint (POST /debug/replay), structured logging with redaction, breakpoint support.
components.gap: MISSING FEATURE: No debugging capabilities beyond console logs.

components.currentBehavior: Minibob reports execution metrics (POST /activity-executions). Backend implements Thompson Sampling. One-way flow (no feedback to vessel).
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Feedback loop (backend recommends templates), impulse usage tracking, learned parameter reuse.
components.gap: PARTIAL: Metrics reported but no feedback loop, no impulse tracking.

components.currentBehavior: Cascade: ENV vars > file config > defaults. No validation, crashes on malformed config.
components.desiredBehavior: Add: Zod schema validation, friendly error messages, config reload endpoint (POST /config/reload).
components.gap: Missing: Schema validation, error handling, hot reload.

dataFlow.userInitiated: HTTP POST /run → handleRunActivity → loadTemplate (MCP/local) → ActivityExecutor.execute → createImpulses (unloaded) → topologicalSort → executeTask (load impulses → format XML → LLM complete → tool loop → validate) → reportExecution (MCP) → HTTP Response
dataFlow.autonomous: Timer (30s) → checkIdle (60s threshold) → fetchTasks (MCP) → sortByPriority → executeBoredomTask (ActivityExecutor) → reportResult (MCP) → resetIdleTimer
dataFlow.acpDelegation: HTTP POST /acp → handleACPRequest → ACPSession.handleMessage → LLM complete → ACP Response
dataFlow.impulseLoading: ContextRequirement → interpolate → create (unloaded) → task references → load (resolve pointer → estimate tokens → truncate if over budget → cache) → formatXML → LLM context
